claim: The sample demo never reads or changes real transfer data.
where: demo banner, demo privacy note, README
sandbox: seed a production license and receipt, enter /demo, mutate and reset demo data, then confirm production sentinels are unchanged

claim: Downloads each receipt as JSON or CSV.
where: receipt actions, landing receipts section, README
sandbox: open /?demo=1 and assert downloaded JSON fields plus CSV header and one row per sample file

claim: File checks and receipt downloads work without a license.
sandbox: fresh /?demo=1 context with no license; assert checked receipt and both downloads

claim: A receipt covers only files selected on the sending phone.
sandbox: seed a selected and an unselected name, transfer through two demo peers, and assert only the selected file appears

claim: Works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: load /demo, wait for service-worker control, go offline, reload, and open the seeded receipt

claim: Free transfers support up to 25 files.
where: landing facts, file chooser, limits section, README
sandbox: fresh /demo?transfer=1; assert 25 files can continue and 26 files cannot

claim: Larger transfers are not for sale while checkout is unavailable.
sandbox: enter through /demo, start for real, and assert the availability notice exists with no checkout action

claim: Transfers selected files through an encrypted direct WebRTC connection with no relay.
where: landing hero and how it works, privacy, README
sandbox: two clean /demo?transfer=1 peers; assert WebRTC uses iceServers: [], completes, and sends no media by HTTP

claim: Connection codes contain connection details, never photo data.
sandbox: fresh /demo?transfer=1 peers; decode both connection codes and assert they contain only an SDP description and no unique photo bytes or filename

claim: Checks the receiving copy and creates a receipt before deletion.
where: landing, demo receipt, how it works, README
sandbox: transfer known bytes between two demo peers and assert a zero-mismatch safe-to-delete receipt

claim: Files keep their original bytes and embedded photo details.
sandbox: transfer a JPEG-like fixture with an EXIF segment, download it, and compare every byte and SHA-256

claim: Received files and receipts stay in this device's browser storage until removed.
sandbox: inspect demo IndexedDB after transfer, remove received copies, and assert the receipt remains

claim: Downloads received files from the receiving PC.
sandbox: download the transferred demo file from the receiver and compare it byte-for-byte with the source

claim: The phone and PC connect directly on the same reachable network.
sandbox: two local demo peers complete a transfer with no STUN or TURN server configured

claim: The app has no analytics, tracking, external fonts, external scripts, photo server, or accounts.
sandbox: capture every request through a full demo transfer and inspect script and stylesheet origins

claim: Interrupted transfers send only missing file parts.
where: how it works, demo interrupted sample, README
sandbox: 20 clean two-peer demo runs; interrupt after saved chunks, reconnect, and assert every saved chunk is retained

claim: The repository includes a Capacitor Android project for this product.
sandbox: inspect the clean repository for the Capacitor web directory, Android launcher activity, intent, and app id
